MediaRemoteAdapter, unmodified.

Project:  https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter
Release:  v0.7.7 (2026-09-03)
Commit:   e3ff5021eb0875858bd05f48d2e9ba2e962d1cf6
Licence:  BSD 3-Clause (see LICENSE). Copyright (c) 2025 Jonas van den Berg and contributors.

Relay uses it to read what is playing on the Mac (Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube in Chrome, Yandex Music
and anything else that shows in Control Center) for the music strip in the notch panel.
scripts/build_macos_app.sh compiles it into Relay.app/Contents/Frameworks. The test client, the CMake files
and the scripts are left out, except src/test/NowPlayingTest.h, which adapter/test.m imports. To update: copy src/adapter, src/private, src/utility, include/ and bin/ from a newer release,
and change this file.
